title: Tip from Angela - Daily Routines
summary: A short motivational tip about building a daily routine to reduce decision fatigue and make learning to code a habit.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: A fixed daily routine reduces the number of decisions to make during the day, which frees energy for learning.
Start the day with a short physical activity such as a walk before sitting down to work.

Do the hardest or most-avoided learning task first, for example a difficult module or concept you keep postponing. Finishing it early gives a sense of achievement and makes the rest of the day easier.
For a multi-day task, aim for at least about an hour on it each day.
Design the morning and day so the routine runs automatically, building towards a daily coding habit.

pitfalls: Postponing the hardest topic until later in the day tends to mean it never gets done.
